newsitem.title: USA: NYPA 965 MW Indian Point 3 nuke reduces power.
newsitem.headline: NYPA 965 MW Indian Point 3 nuke reduces power.

text.p: New York Power Authority's (NYPA) 965 megawatt Indian Point nuclear power unit 3 reduced electrical output over the weekend while the company studied a main turbine generator vibration, a spokesman said Monday.
The unit was operating at 88 percent of capacity as of early Monday morning, spokesman Carl Patrick said.
"We are not planning to reduce power any further, we are reviewing the situation now," the spokesman said.
NYPA had not yet decided if repairs to correct the vibration would be necessary, and no timetable had been set for full production from the unit, Patrick said.
